examples.label: Example 1
examples.input:
9
new 6 10
hold 1 2 0
hold 2 3 1
hold 3 2 2
freeSeats 2
buy 1 5
freeSeats 11
buy 2 11
hold 3 2 11
examples.display:
calls   = SeatHolder(6, 10), hold(1, 2, 0), hold(2, 3, 1),
          hold(3, 2, 2), freeSeats(2), buy(1, 5),
          freeSeats(11), buy(2, 11), hold(3, 2, 11)
results = null, 0, 2, -1, 1, true, 4, false, 2

User 3 finds no two free seats side by side at time 2. User 2 does not pay, so at time 11 seats 2 to 4 are free again and the late buy fails.

examples.label: Example 2
examples.input:
7
new 4 100
hold 1 1 0
hold 2 1 0
hold 3 1 0
release 1 1
hold 4 2 1
freeSeats 1
examples.display:
calls   = SeatHolder(4, 100), hold(1, 1, 0), hold(2, 1, 0),
          hold(3, 1, 0), release(1, 1), hold(4, 2, 1),
          freeSeats(1)
results = null, 0, 1, 2, true, -1, 2

After the release, seats 0 and 3 are free, but they are not side by side.
